finding: Slovak firms' discouragement rate fell below euro area level in wave 39
bullets: The share of Slovak firms (n=131) that did not apply for bank loans fearing rejection fell from 5.76% (wave 38) to 1.81% (wave 39), below the EA's 2.37% (n=3,607).
Slovak firms' bank loan application rate remained well below the EA average (n=3,607), with the rejection rate too sparse to permit a reliable financing gap estimate for Slovakia.
The EA financing gap eased from 4.54% (wave 38) to 3.48% (n=3,607) in wave 39, as both EA discouragement and rejection rates declined.
chart_subtitle: Slovak discouragement rate fell to 1.81% in wave 39.
